texts.arguments: 2. The petitioner has been convicted under Sections 16(1)(A)(I)(II) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo 1 year R.I., with fine of Rs.5000/- and usual default stipulations. 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the Court below has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicant. The applicant has suffered one month in custody out of total sentence of one year R.I.
